Requirements for pane primitives

Normative behaviour of the terminal, agent, editor and basic pane primitives.

The rows follow the format and the observation channels of the requirements index. The id prefix is PRI. The id PRI-009 is intentionally unused: it was retired and ids are never reused, so the numbering runs from PRI-008 to PRI-010.

Id Requirement Source Observable test
[PRI-001] A screen read MUST need terminal.read-screen. read-cells is a separate grant, terminal.read-cells, and MUST accept at most 1,000 rows per call and return quota-exceeded above that. edge cases and errors (sync-return) read-cells with 1,001 rows -> quota-exceeded.
[PRI-002] history-text over 4 MiB MUST keep the newest 4 MiB. requestable limits (sync-return) read history of 5 MiB -> 4 MiB, the newest.
[PRI-003] send-input MUST accept at most 16 stages, a total stage delay of 10 s and 64 KiB of raw bytes. Above any of them it MUST refuse with invalid-argument. primitives terminal input (completion) 17 stages -> refused(invalid-argument).
[PRI-004] Check order for send-input MUST be: capability, stage and size rules, if-current precondition, then the lock. A failed precondition MUST refuse the intent before any lock is taken. capability terminal input lock (completion) stale if-current on a locked pane -> refused(conflict) and the lock unchanged.
[PRI-005] An input lock MUST last at most 2 s. There MUST be one lock per pane. A second lock MUST return conflict. requestable limits (sync-return) lock a locked pane -> conflict.
[PRI-006] A terminal output filter MUST accept at most rate_per_second matches per filter instance and pane. A match above the limit MUST be dropped and counted, not delivered. capability terminal output filter (event-delivery) 500 matches in a second at rate 10 -> 10 delivered, the next batch starts with events-dropped.
[PRI-007] A pointer claim MUST belong to one plugin at a time. A whole-pane claim belongs to one pane, so a second whole claim on the same pane MUST return conflict. primitives terminal pointer (sync-return) two plugins claim one pane -> the second gets conflict.
[PRI-008] screen-changed MUST be delivered at most 10 times per second per pane. requestable limits (event-delivery) change a screen 100 times a second -> at most 10 events.
[PRI-010] register-signature MUST return invalid-argument for a rule with a bad id, process names, aliases, icon, action count or key size, and conflict for an id the manifest already contributes. errors and edge cases (sync-return) register a signature with an empty id -> invalid-argument.
[PRI-011] A signature of the user MUST win over a plugin signature, which MUST win over a built-in one. An overlap MUST be logged as a warning. errors and edge cases (log-line) two signatures match one process -> one warning, the user rule applies.
[PRI-012] set-toolbar-state MUST return not-found for a button that is not the plugin own or a pane that does not exist, and not-permitted without the grant. errors and edge cases (sync-return) set state for another plugin button -> not-found.
[PRI-013] agents() MUST return an empty list when agent.read is declined. view, session and last_prompt MUST return none. errors and edge cases (sync-return) call agents() without the grant -> empty list.
[PRI-014] A transcript per call MUST hold at most 512 turns or 4 MiB. The oldest turns MUST be dropped. requestable limits (sync-return) read a 600 turn transcript -> 512 turns, newest.
[PRI-015] A pane MUST have no activity before its agent-identified event. A restored pane MUST report none. errors and edge cases (sync-return) read activity of a restored pane -> none.
[PRI-020] read-lines MUST accept at most 10,000 lines per call. Over that MUST return invalid-argument. limits (sync-return) read 10,001 lines -> invalid-argument.
[PRI-021] A plugin MUST hold at most 64 buffers. The 65th create-buffer MUST return quota-exceeded. create-buffer text MUST be at most 16 MiB. limits (sync-return) create a 65th buffer -> quota-exceeded.
[PRI-022] editor-apply-edits MUST accept at most 10,000 edits and refuse more with refused(invalid-argument). limits (completion) 10,001 edits -> refused(invalid-argument) and the buffer unchanged.
[PRI-023] An annotator MUST be called at most once per 100 ms per buffer. Extra calls MUST NOT be made. limits (event-delivery) edit 20 times in 100 ms -> one annotator call.
[PRI-024] Decorations or gutter marks MUST be at most 10,000 per layer; the session total MUST be at most 65,536. limits (sync-return) 10,001 marks in a layer -> invalid-argument.
[PRI-030] A basic pane MUST draw its body from views.render and MUST receive on-events like any plugin side. body and lifecycle (screen-text) open a basic pane -> the rendered body appears.
[PRI-031] set-dirty with true MUST mark the pane as holding unsaved work, and closing it MUST ask before discarding. pane activity and dirty state (screen-text) set-dirty true, then close the pane -> a confirmation appears.
